entities.summary: María Rafaela de los Dolores y del Patrocinio, more commonly known as Sor Patrocinio, also known as "the nun of the wounds", was a Spanish nun of the Order of the Immaculate Conception. She was prominent in the Spanish social and political spheres in the second half of the 19th century through her influence over Queen Isabel II and the queen's husband, King Francisco de Asís de Borbón.
